services.name: Private Lessons by the Hour
services.desc: Looking for one-on-one guidance with your sewing or quilting projects? Private lessons are a great way to get personalized instruction tailored to your specific goals, skill level, and learning style. Whether you are brand new to sewing or an experienced quilter wanting help with a particular technique, private lessons provide focused support in a relaxed and encouraging environment. Lessons are completely customized to your needs. You are welcome to bring your own project, pattern, and materials, or we can decide together what would be most helpful for your lesson time.
